{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the data is clean
print("Shape after deduplication:", trial_df.shape)
print("\nValue counts for `sex`:")
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for `arm`:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for `severity`:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arm assignment is confounded with severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of `arm` vs `severity`:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))"}
